scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Restate the customer's issue in your own words rather than repeating her exact sentence verbatim at [00:40] ('Your Netflix and Disney+ entertainment bundle activation token expired before you could link your account').

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Note down the customer's email address when she spells out 'violetta.kowalski88@gmail.com' at [02:23] so you do not ask her what email address to send the token to at [07:30].

grader.scenario: Netflix and Disney+ entertainment bundle activation token expired before customer could link her S-Net account
grader.notes: Good call (83.3) with two clear technical deduction failures: at [00:40] Chloe echoes Violetta's exact words from [00:10] verbatim (PA FAIL), and at [07:30] she asks what email address to send the new activation link to after Violetta spelled out violetta.kowalski88@gmail.com letter-by-letter at [02:23] (AL FAIL). All other 9 criteria pass clearly, including live resolution confirmation of both Netflix and Disney+ linking on the call ([08:18]-[09:51]).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Greeting at [00:00] ('thank you for calling S-Net') and closing with survey check at [12:00] ('Thank you for choosing S-Net').

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Single managed 52s hold between [04:42] ('Please bear with me while I revoke token batch ENT-88219...') and [05:55] ('Thank you for holding, Violetta!').

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: At [00:40]-[01:02] (within 2 minutes) Agent verified postcode (GU1 3RX), address (14 Sycamore Avenue), and 4-digit security PIN (3185).

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: At [00:19] and [07:46] Agent apologized warmly and acknowledged how disappointing it was to have family movie night delayed.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: At [00:40] Agent parroted the customer's exact words from [00:10] verbatim ('Your Netflix and Disney+ entertainment bundle activation token expired before you could link your account') instead of paraphrasing.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: At [02:23] Customer clearly stated and spelled out 'violetta.kowalski88@gmail.com', and Agent claimed 'Got that noted' at [02:31], but at [07:30] Agent asked 'And what email address would you like me to send the new activation token to?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: At [04:25]-[06:11] and [10:20], Agent purged the stuck ENT-410 session tokens in the Partner Entitlement Gateway, issued new tokens PEG-550912 and PEG-550913, guided live linking, and applied a £5 pro-rata credit.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Warm, friendly rapport throughout, including chatting about the customer's family trip to Krakow ([01:55]) and watching Inside Out 2 ([11:18]-[11:30]).

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed the exact error code ENT-410 ([01:16]), whether existing Netflix/Disney+ accounts and card billing were active ([02:13], [02:31]), device/browser/content blockers ([03:08]), and Wi-Fi vs VPN connection ([03:28]).

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: At [08:18]-[09:51] and [11:43], Violetta clicked the new links live on her iPad and confirmed both Netflix and Disney+ show 'Linked to S-Net Billing'.
